card.title: Ready on My Terms
card.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll talk about last night's rent argument, but not the whole year tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole year matters. You've been pulling away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It does. One question, and let me finish before you answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Were you going to move out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I packed a bag. It's still upstairs. Please let that be the whole answer for a minute.

mechanism: A agrees to painful honesty by restricting its scope, turn-taking and duration enough to remain emotionally safe.
confusable: Unlike refusal or evasive delay, the protected form must enable a real vulnerable admission.
comparison: A rent dispute narrows to an admission about a packed bag; the alternative uses a physical exit and limits reunion.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
